siems._comment0: SIEM type: splunk, elastic, opensearch, or standard (for generic JSON-based SIEMs)
siems._comment1: Endpoint URL (Splunk HEC: https://<host>:8088/services/collector/event for on-prem or cloud)
siems._comment3: Authentication token (required for Splunk HEC; optional for standard)
siems._comment4: Path to CA certificate file (e.g., /app/certs/ca.pem) for self-signed/custom CA; set to null for trusted CAs
siems._comment5: Enable SSL verification (true/false); set to false only for testing with warning
siems._comment6: Splunk index for logs (optional, defaults to main)
siems._comment8: Batch size for this SIEM (optional, overrides global batch_size)
siems._comment9: Optional username and password for basic auth (if needed instead of token)

siems._comment10: Endpoint URL (Elasticsearch: https://<host>:9200 for on-prem or cloud)
siems._comment12: Authentication token (optional, use for API key - base64 encoded 'id:api_key' or tuple via code)
siems._comment13: Optional username and password for basic auth (overrides token if set)

siems._comment15: Endpoint URL (OpenSearch: https://<host>:9200 for on-prem or AWS)
siems._comment17: Authentication token (optional, use for API key or bearer token)
siems._comment18: Optional AWS region for AWS SigV4 auth (if set, uses AWS credentials from env)
siems._comment19: Optional username and password for basic auth (overrides token if set)

siems._comment21: Endpoint URL for generic JSON POST (e.g., QRadar, ArcSight)

_comment24: Log directories to monitor (discovered automatically if empty)
_comment25: Log format: text, csv, or xml
_comment26: Global batch size for log parsing (overridden by siem.batch_size if specified)
_comment27: Field mappings for custom SIEM fields (used for standard type)
